_comment: Development sign-in accounts for the Playground. Read by BOTH the Next tier's
`npm run demo:users` (which creates them through Better Auth's own API) and the
backend seeder (which enrols them in the seeded workspace with these roles).
One list rather than two, so the two halves cannot drift.
These are NOT a bypass. Each account is created by the same sign-up route a
browser uses, with a password Better Auth hashes and a verification token
Better Auth mints. Nothing about the authentication pipeline differs — the
Addresses use the reserved `.example` TLD deliberately: it can never resolve,
so a build that one day has a real email transport cannot send anything to a
`role` is one of Signora's two workspace roles. Sales titles are in `persona`
because the product does not model them — see RUNNING.md.
